tool: Built-in image_gen, followed by native vector construction for clean transparent exports.

variants.name: czytelny-monogram
variants.desc: Create the most readable two-letter arrangement: a curved uppercase E occupies the left half of the round body, and a curved S occupies the right half. E's outer spine follows the left circumference; its three arms turn inward with rounded terminals. S's upper and lower lobes finish the right circumference. Two separate, beautifully balanced letter strokes with a narrow vertical negative-space channel. Medium stroke weight. The top power bar is a separate rounded vertical capsule.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset: EasyShut Windows application icon, one design only, centered on a square canvas. Use the attached hand drawing as a concept reference and the other reference as a power-symbol reference, not as something to trace literally. Design a sophisticated rounded monogram made from the uppercase letters E and S. The actual letter strokes must bend and join to form an overall near-circular silhouette, evoking an on/off power button. Place one short upright stroke at twelve o'clock, raised a little above the circular body with a small clear separation. E must still be recognizable as E with three arms, S must still be recognizable as S. The letters themselves create the circular body; do not simply put normal ES text inside a separate circle. PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) opaque icon strokes, REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND including the holes and surrounding canvas. Round every endcap and join; smooth optical curves, no pointed angles. Flat vector-like logo, crisp clean edges, small-size legibility, consistent optical weight. Plenty of clear margin, icon occupying about 76% of square width. No shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no border, no checkerboard pixels, no colored background, no lettering other than the E/S monogram, no labels or variant numbers.
Specific variant direction: Create the most readable two-letter arrangement: a curved uppercase E occupies the left half of the round body, and a curved S occupies the right half. E's outer spine follows the left circumference; its three arms turn inward with rounded terminals. S's upper and lower lobes finish the right circumference. Two separate, beautifully balanced letter strokes with a narrow vertical negative-space channel. Medium stroke weight. The top power bar is a separate rounded vertical capsule.

variants.name: spleciony
variants.desc: Create a flowing intertwined monogram inspired most closely by the hand sketch: the round outer spine and three soft arms of E interlock with a broad sweeping S, whose diagonal waist traverses the center. Shared contours and flowing negative space make one compact circular gesture, still clearly containing E and S. Slightly lighter monoline weight, all joins soft. A short detached power bar at the top completes the symbol.

variants.name: mocny-znak
variants.desc: Create a bold compact emblem especially legible as a tiny taskbar icon. Use thick rounded E and S strokes fitted tightly together within a nearly circular footprint, with generous simple transparent gaps separating the three arms of the E and the two lobes of the S. The E left spine and S right curve form most of the power button perimeter. Strong symmetry of overall silhouette and a thick short capsule power stroke raised at twelve o'clock. This is a strong chunky monogram, not a hollow circle containing separate text.

variants.name: otwarty-okrag
variants.desc: Create an airy open-ring monogram, a graceful near-circle deliberately open at the top around the detached power stroke. E is built from a rounded left arc with three inward rounded horizontal branches, while an elongated curved S forms the right arc and sweeps gracefully across the lower center. Use clean, delicate but usable medium-thin monoline strokes, much more negative space than a heavy icon. The circle is formed by letters only, with a smooth circular baseline and softly rounded terminals.

variants.name: wspolna-linia
variants.desc: Create a distinctive unified ribbon-like E/S monogram: a rounded E on the left and an S on the right share a central curving stroke and one flowing lower semicircular contour. Their shared structure makes the circular silhouette feel like one carefully constructed symbol, with the E's three arms clearly visible as rounded horizontal segments and a large readable S curve. Medium-bold weight, slightly more horizontal center movement than the symmetrical concepts. A detached upright rounded capsule floats slightly above the twelve-o'clock opening to make the on/off association immediate.
